info.title: GovCon 30/60/90-Day Phase-In Transition Plan API
info.description: Generates a risk-mitigated 30/60/90-Day Phase-In and Phase-Out Transition Plan with chronological Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) milestones, Executive Order 14055 / Service Contract Act (SCA) Incumbent Right-of-First-Refusal retention strategies and outreach scripts, DD-254 / DISS security clearance crossover timelines, side-by-side knowledge transfer and Operational Readiness Review (ORR) gates, a FAR 52.237-3 Continuity of Services checklist, and a paste-ready Shipley Transition Plan proposal volume. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.description: Transforms solicitation Section C/L/M transition instructions and incumbent workforce context into a 30/60/90-Day WBS Phase-In/Out Transition Plan, EO 14055 / SCA Incumbent Capture Plan, DD-254/DISS clearance transfer schedule, Knowledge Transfer ORR tracks, FAR 52.237-3 checklist, and Shipley Transition Volume narrative.

solicitation_transition_and_sow_text.description: Solicitation Section C/L/M transition instructions, PWS scope, incumbent staffing size, clearance levels, and continuity-of-operations mandates (30 to 75,000 characters).

incumbent_workforce_and_clearance_contex.description: Optional incumbent contractor details, target FTE count, Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) / Service Contract Act (SCA) context, and DD-254 facility/personnel security clearance transfer requirements.

example.solicitation_transition_and_sow_text: Section L.4.3 & PWS C.2 Phase-In / Phase-Out Transition (60-Day Phase-In / 90-Day FOC): The incoming Prime Contractor shall execute a zero-mission-disruption transition for a 38-FTE Enterprise Cloud, Zero-Trust ICAM, and 24x7 Tier-2/3 Service Desk operation supporting Tennessee STS and DoD mission partners. Full Operational Capability (FOC) is required at Day 60, with Days 61-90 dedicated to steady-state SLA optimization.
example.incumbent_workforce_and_clearance_contex: Incumbent prime currently staffs 38 FTEs (28 Secret cleared, 10 Top Secret/SCI cleared under DD Form 254; 14 Service Contract Act [SCA] helpdesk/network technicians subject to EO 14055 right-of-first-refusal). Target incumbent capture rate is >= 90% with 6 pre-cleared bench engineers ready on Day 1.

200.description: Complete 30/60/90-Day Phase-In / Phase-Out Transition & Incumbent Capture Plan
